Title: Exclude changed KOL history outside the reporting month
Preconditions: A test claim has a changed historical KOL record with transaction_date outside the selected reporting month. The extract run and source/history data can be inspected.
Test Data: Claim ID: CLAIM_HIST_01; reporting month: REPORT_MONTH; historical KOL: HISTORICAL_KOL; transaction_date: DATE_OUTSIDE_REPORT_MONTH
Test Steps: 1. Record the claim ID, reporting month, historical KOL value, and transaction_date from claim history. 2. Generate the SDM extract for REPORT_MONTH. 3. Locate the claim in the extract and compare rows with the historical record. 4. Reconcile the result using the claim ID and reporting month.
Expected Results: The out-of-period changed historical KOL record does not appear as a generated row in the current month's extract. The claim's history remains distinguishable from current-period output, and the excluded historical record does not cause a blank KOL through the scenario described in CSR-612.

Title: Preserve an otherwise eligible current-month KOL record
Preconditions: A claim has a changed KOL record whose transaction_date is within the selected reporting month and the record satisfies existing SDM eligibility rules.
Test Data: Claim ID: CLAIM_CURR_01; reporting month: REPORT_MONTH; current KOL: CURRENT_KOL; transaction_date: DATE_WITHIN_REPORT_MONTH
Test Steps: 1. Confirm the record's date falls within REPORT_MONTH using the approved timezone and boundary conventions. 2. Confirm it is otherwise eligible under existing SDM rules. 3. Generate the SDM extract. 4. Compare the claim's extract row and KOL value with the authoritative current claim data and UI state.
Expected Results: The fix does not suppress the otherwise eligible current-month record. The output's claim association and KOL value agree with the authoritative current claim data. Existing eligibility rules determine inclusion.

Title: Validate reporting-month boundary dates
Preconditions: Approved timezone, timestamp conversion, and inclusive/exclusive month-boundary rules are documented for the extract.
Test Data: Changed KOL records dated immediately before the month, at the first valid instant/date, at the last valid instant/date, and immediately after the month
Test Steps: 1. Prepare otherwise comparable changed KOL records for each boundary position. 2. Generate the SDM extract for the target month. 3. Compare each record's normalized transaction_date with the approved reporting-month boundaries. 4. Verify each record's inclusion or exclusion in the output.
Expected Results: Records outside the target month are excluded from its extract. Records on or within the month boundaries are handled according to the approved existing date and timezone rules; no assumption about inclusive timestamp semantics is introduced by this test.

Acceptance Criteria: AC1.1; AC1.2; AC2.1 (inferred); AC3.1; AC3.2; AC3.4
Title: Reconcile multiple KOL versions for one claim
Preconditions: A claim has multiple historical KOL versions, including at least one changed out-of-period record and one current-period record otherwise eligible under existing rules.
Test Data: Claim ID: CLAIM_MULTI_01; historical versions: KOL_VERSION_OLD and KOL_VERSION_CURRENT; dates: DATE_OUTSIDE_REPORT_MONTH and DATE_WITHIN_REPORT_MONTH
Test Steps: 1. Capture the claim ID and each available KOL value, transaction_date, and version/change indicator from history. 2. Check the current claim representation in the UI. 3. Generate the extract for REPORT_MONTH. 4. Reconcile the generated rows to the history versions by claim ID, KOL value, and date.
Expected Results: The out-of-period historical version is not generated in the current extract. The otherwise eligible current-period record is not lost because older history exists. The UI's current state is not mistaken for a complete historical record set.

Title: Verify the CSR-609 blank-KOL regression scenario
Preconditions: A reproducible claim matching the CSR-609 analysis is available, and the authoritative current KOL value can be identified from approved claim data.
Test Data: Claim ID: CLAIM_CSR609_REPRO; reporting month: REPORT_MONTH; known historical changed KOL record and transaction_date; authoritative current KOL value
Test Steps: 1. Capture the claim's current UI state and relevant historical KOL versions before the run. 2. Generate the corrected SDM extract for REPORT_MONTH. 3. Inspect all output rows for the claim, including KOL values and dates where available. 4. Compare the output with the authoritative current claim data and record any discrepancy with its source location.
Expected Results: The targeted out-of-period historical record is not generated in the current extract and does not produce the reported blank-KOL result. The current-period output agrees with the authoritative current claim data. This result does not define handling for unrelated null KOL cases.

Title: Confirm extract generation does not delete or alter historical source data
Preconditions: Read-only access is available to the source claim and history data, and the approved logical keys and columns are mapped to the actual schema.
Test Data: Claim ID: CLAIM_HIST_01; historical KOL value; transaction_date; version/change indicator if present
Test Steps: 1. Using approved read-only database queries, capture the matching source/history record and its relevant values before extract generation. 2. Generate the SDM extract for REPORT_MONTH. 3. Re-query the same source/history record using its stable key. 4. Compare the before-and-after source values and verify the extract result separately.
Expected Results: The source historical record remains present and its relevant values are unchanged by extract generation. Its absence from the current extract is achieved by extract selection, not destructive modification of claim history.

Title: Compare the database-derived period candidate set with extract output
Preconditions: The database schema, extract staging/output mapping, reporting-month parameter, and approved date-boundary rules are available. Use read-only queries.
Test Data: A controlled set containing eligible current-month records and changed KOL records with transaction_date before and after REPORT_MONTH
Test Steps: 1. Query the source/history data for the controlled claim set using the approved reporting-month boundaries and logical record eligibility rules. 2. Generate the extract for the same REPORT_MONTH. 3. Map source records to output rows using the approved claim and record keys. 4. Compare expected and actual candidate sets, including missing and extra rows.
Expected Results: The generated output contains no targeted out-of-period changed historical record. Otherwise eligible current-period records are not omitted. Any differences are reported by claim/record key and are not hidden by aggregate counts.

Acceptance Criteria: AC1.1; AC1.4; AC2.1 (inferred); AC3.1; AC3.2; AC3.5
Title: Verify KOL-to-claim and version association in extracted data
Preconditions: The actual source and output schema mappings for claim ID, KOL value, transaction_date, and version/change status are documented. A claim with multiple KOL versions is available.
Test Data: Claim ID: CLAIM_MULTI_01; historical and current KOL versions; reporting month: REPORT_MONTH
Test Steps: 1. Use read-only queries to retrieve all relevant source/history versions for the claim. 2. Retrieve the corresponding extract output rows for REPORT_MONTH. 3. Compare claim identifiers and mapped KOL/date/version attributes. 4. Check for output rows corresponding to out-of-period changed versions and for blank KOL values attributable to those versions.
Expected Results: Each emitted row is associated with the correct claim and eligible KOL record according to existing SDM rules. No row is emitted for the targeted out-of-period changed historical version, and no blank KOL is introduced through that version-selection path.
